summary: Applied both spec review repairs by extending the durable finalize-cleanup path contract to explicit --log-file and config.logs.dir paths that resolve inside the deleted worktree.

items.title: Explicit runtime log path bypasses relocation
items.rationale: The spec now states that finalize-cleanup relocates `--log-file` paths that resolve inside the deleted worktree to the main repository using the same relative path, while honoring outside-worktree absolute paths.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[5], requirements[R4], requirements[R5], acceptance_criteria[4], acceptance_criteria[7], and tasks[T-2] now cover explicit --log-file behavior.

items.title: Configured logger dir bypasses agentWorkDir relocation
items.rationale: The spec now states that finalize-cleanup relocates `config.logs.dir` when it resolves inside the deleted worktree, while honoring outside-worktree absolute log directory overrides.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[6], requirements[R4], requirements[R5], acceptance_criteria[5], acceptance_criteria[7], and tasks[T-2] now cover configured logger directory behavior.
